base: An old hurt can make the next opportunity look dangerous for reasons that belong partly to what happened before.
business: A practical mismatch needs adjustment; change the arrangement instead of repeating the same workaround.
shadow: Pressure escalates when each side keeps demanding terms the other cannot sustain.
arcApplying: The mismatch becomes harder to work around as exactness approaches.
arcSeparating: The pressure eases after exactness, leaving the changed arrangement to prove itself.

readerCopy.body: An old hurt can make the next opportunity look dangerous for reasons that belong partly to what happened before. When Chiron squares the North Node, criticism, visibility, or entering a similar situation can bring an earlier experience back into the decision with far more authority than it deserves. The fear may still contain useful information about what needs protection now. Update the boundary or secure better support, but do not assume the only safe choice is avoiding anything that resembles the old problem.
